notes.title: Patch 2 is Live!
notes.notes:
[h2][/h2][previewyoutube="r9u3uLX2M-s;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]Second Patch[/h2][p]We’ve been hard at work expanding and refining [b]Upin & Ipin Universe[/b] to make your adventures more exciting and smoother than ever. Patch 2 introduces brand-new content, important fixes, and long-awaited quality-of-life improvements. Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p][b]Fresh Merdeka Content[/b] – Merdeka-themed decorations across Kampung Durian Runtuh and Firework Celebration by Tok Dalang.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Streamer Mode[/b] – Added a Streamer Mode under the Gameplay Settings.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gameplay Fixes[/b] – From RC collisions to quest markers, we’ve addressed multiple issues.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI Improvements[/b] – Cooking and Fishing activity UIs now function seamlessly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quality-of-Life[/b] – Basic cooked dishes inventory added, improved save slots, and smoother quest flow.[/p][/*][/list][p]No matter how you play fishing, racing, cooking, or completing quests this update makes your journey better than ever.
[/p][p]Please check out the full patch notes below. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684481/8d79efca91639c6d2da59469a1d1218741008ae2.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Patch 2 Notes – Steam[/h3][h3]
New Content[/h3][p][b]Merdeka Celebration[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new Merdeka-themed decorations across Kampung Durian Runtuh.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Firework Celebration by Tok Dalang. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Streamer Mode[/b][/p][list][*][p]Implemented a dedicated mode for streamers under the Gameplay Settings.[/p][/*][/list][h3]
Gameplay & Quest Fixes[/h3][p][b]Quest Flow[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Quest markers for certain quests now display correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Errand no longer blocks the opening of the pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p]PPP can now be replayed without blockers after leaving it unfinished.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]RC Car Racing[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed RC car collision issues for smoother multiplayer play.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gasing Preview[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Player 1 first-time preview issue with the gasing activity.[/p][/*][/list][h3]
UI & Controls[/h3][p][b]Cooking[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed UI issues for cooking activity.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fishing[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Fishing activity UI for Player 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where players could still interact with objects while the fishing bait menu was open.[/p][/*][/list][h3]
Systems & Inventory[/h3][p][b]Save Slots[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved save slot functionality and stability.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Basic Inventory[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a cooked dishes to inventory system for players.[/p][/*][/list][h3]
Map & Visuals[/h3][p][b]Map Details[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed disappearance of map details.[/p][/*][/list][h3]
General Fixes & Polish[/h3][list][*][p]Overall bug fixes and refinements based on community feedback and testing.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]
Note:[/b] Existing progress and saved data remain unaffected.[/p][p]Thank you for playing and supporting [b]Upin & Ipin Universe![/b] Keep sharing your feedback, it helps us make the game even better.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1 is Live!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]First Patch
 [/b][/h2][p]We’ve been listening to your feedback and working hard to bring you a smoother, more enjoyable experience in [b]Upin & Ipin Universe[/b]. Patch 1 delivers a variety of improvements, bug fixes, and polish to make your adventures even better!  Here’s what’s new: - [b]Better visuals & lighting[/b] – Nighttime scenes now look more atmospheric, with smoother motion and 
reduced ghosting.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684481/b9ef410c7340238d50621c0e5c42ffa4bb6029f3.jpg"][/img]- [b]Gameplay fixes[/b] – Improved bike controls, RC racing updates, and more!
- [b]Quest adjustments[/b] – “Chef Ehsan” quest is now easier to master.
- [b]Bug fixes[/b] – From animations to trophies, we’ve tackled player-reported issues.[/p][p][/p][p]Whether you’re racing RC cars, completing quests, or just enjoying the world, we hope these updates make your journey even more fun.[/p][p][/p][p]Please do check out the full patch notes below 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684481/5566c7277ae05bbb1c9c0b511b0796e604908234.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Patch 1 Notes – Steam[/b][/h3][p][b]Tarik Upih Animation[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed: Tarik Upih now displays the correct in-air animation when airborne.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bike Camera Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Auto-centering camera is now disabled by default.[/p][/*][*][p]Bike camera is now fully controllable.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Trophy System Bug[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue preventing trophies from unlocking properly.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Nighttime Lighting[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved nighttime lighting for better atmosphere and visibility.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]RC Car Racing[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added player indicators for both Upin and Ipin in RC car racing.[/p][/*][*][p]RC units no longer collide with players, and players no longer block each other.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Save System[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved save system stability.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the risk of data corruption.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]“Chef Ehsan” Quest[/b][/p][list][*][p]Made it significantly easier to achieve the “Perfect Chef” ranking.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dialogue freeze during the “Chef Ehsan” quest.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]NPCs Near Water[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where NPCs would appear near rivers and ponds.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]General Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]General bug fixes and polish based on player feedback and internal testing.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]General Visuals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enhanced motion blur and TAA for smoother visuals and reduced ghosting.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Jumping Animation[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed T-pose issue when jumping onto beds.[/p][/*][/list][p]Note: Existing progress and saved data remain unaffected.

Thank you for playing and supporting [b]Upin & Ipin Universe[/b]! Keep sharing your feedback, it helps us make the game even better. [/p]

notes.title: A Message to Our Fans
notes.notes:
[p]Hi Fans,[/p][p]We've been working hard to present Upin & Ipin Universe to the world and we're glad that it's finally here. It’s been a week since launch, and we wanted to give you an update on why we’ve been a bit quiet. We’ve been heads down, reading your feedback, squashing bugs, and working hard to improve the game experience.[/p][p][b]We want to address two major concerns: Pricing & Demonetization of Streamers:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Our team has invested a tremendous amount of time and effort to create an experience that meets the expectations of Upin & Ipin fans around the world. We believe the current pricing reflects the quality and value of the game. Please know that more content is on the way, content that will expand and enrich the universe, but it takes time to develop and release properly. We truly appreciate your patience and support as we continue building.[/p][/*][*][p]We’re aware that some streamers have been demonetized due to copyright flags. We are working on a solution, [u]like a Streamer Mode[/u], but need more time. Please be aware that all in-game music is copyrighted and may be [b]automatically flagged by streaming platforms.[/b] To avoid this, we recommend muting the music while streaming. The best approach is to always follow the guidelines of the platform you’re using to stay safe.[/p][/*][/list][p]Last weekend, we released our first major patch. This weekend, we’ll be rolling out another update focused on additional fixes and quality-of-life improvements.[/p][p]Open world games are challenging to launch, and we also experienced our fair share of surprises. Several critical issues surfaced which we will be tackling over the coming weeks as patches regularly roll out. Key concerns voiced by the community are 2-player camera, bike and rendering issues on PS4 & Switch in particular.[/p][p][b]For the full list of updates and what’s coming next, be sure to [/b][url="https://discord.gg/S533cfmx6vs://"]join our Discord community[/url][b].[/b] You’ll be the first to hear about new features, patch notes, and ongoing support. We’re incredibly grateful to everyone who’s taken the time to share constructive feedback and support the team. This game has been a labor of love for years, and we’re just getting started.[/p][p]Soon, we’ll be sharing our roadmap and how we plan to continue supporting and expanding the game.[/p][p]Most importantly, we want to keep building with you, the longtime fans of Upin & Ipin, and the new fans discovering the twins for the first time. As more players join from around the world, we welcome your questions about the game, the culture, and anything you’re curious about. This is our way of sharing a little piece of Malaysia with the world, and celebrating all the amazing things the region has to offer.[/p][p]So get ready. The journey’s just beginning.[/p][p]Thank you for being part of it, and let’s keep playing![/p][p][b]Yes, Yes, Yes![/b][/p][p]— Dev Team @ Streamline Studios / Les' Copaque

---

Salam hormat buat komuniti Upin & Ipin Universe,[/p][p]Kami sangat teruja dapat memperkenalkan Upin & Ipin Universe kepada dunia! Terima kasih atas sokongan, maklum balas dan kesabaran anda. Sepanjang minggu ini, pasukan kami fokus sepenuhnya pada penambahbaikan permainan termasuk pembetulan bug dan penyesuaian berdasarkan komen anda semua.[/p][p][b]2 isu utama yang ingin kami sentuh:[/b][/p][p]Pasukan kami telah melaburkan masa dan usaha yang besar untuk membina pengalaman yang memenuhi jangkaan peminat Upin & Ipin dari seluruh dunia. Harga semasa mencerminkan kualiti dan nilai permainan ini. Kami ingin anda tahu bahawa lebih banyak kandungan akan datang yang akan mengembangkan lagi dunia ini. Tapi semua itu perlukan masa untuk dibangunkan dan dilancar dengan baik. Kami sangat hargai kesabaran dan sokongan anda sepanjang proses ini.[/p][p]Kami juga sedar ada penstrim (streamer) yang menghadapi isu disebabkan tanda hak cipta pada muzik dalam permainan. Kami sedang usahakan penyelesaian seperti Streamer Mode, namun ia akan ambil sedikit masa.  Buat masa ini, muzik dalam permainan mungkin [b]ditandakan (flag) secara automatik oleh platform penstriman.[/b] Untuk elak masalah ini, kami cadangkan agar muzik dimatikan semasa penstriman dan sentiasa ikut garis panduan platform yang digunakan.[/p][p]Pada hujung minggu lalu, kami telah melancarkan patch pertama. Hujung minggu ini, satu lagi kemas kini akan diperkenalkan, dengan fokus kepada pembetulan tambahan serta penambahbaikan kualiti pengalaman bermain.[/p][p]Kami sedar bahawa pelancaran permainan dunia terbuka datang dengan cabarannya tersendiri dan kami juga tidak terkecuali. Beberapa isu kritikal telah dikenal pasti dan akan ditangani secara berperingkat melalui patch yang dijadualkan dalam minggu-minggu akan datang. Antara isu utama yang dibangkitkan oleh komuniti termasuk kamera dua pemain, basikal, serta masalah rendering, khususnya pada platform PS4 dan Switch akan diperbaiki segera.[/p][p][b]Untuk maklumat terkini serta ciri-ciri baharu yang akan datang, [/b][url="https://discord.gg/S533cfmx6v"]jangan lupa sertai komuniti Discord kami![/url][/p][p]Anda akan menjadi antara yang pertama mengetahui tentang kemas kini, nota patch, dan pelan penambahbaikan yang sedang dirancang.[/p][p]Kami amat menghargai setiap maklum balas membina dan sokongan berterusan daripada anda semua.[/p][p]Permainan ini merupakan hasil usaha penuh dedikasi dan komitmen selama bertahun-tahun dan ini[/p][p]hanyalah permulaan.[/p][p]Dalam masa terdekat, kami akan berkongsi hala tuju permainan ini serta rancangan kami untuk terus[/p][p]menyokong dan mengembangkannya.[/p][p]Paling utama, kami ingin terus membina dunia ini bersama anda peminat setia Upin & Ipin, serta pemain baharu yang baru mengenali pasangan kembar ini. Dengan semakin ramai pemain dari seluruh dunia menyertai komuniti ini, kami mengalu-alukan segala pertanyaan anda sama ada tentang permainan, budaya, atau apa sahaja yang ingin anda ketahui. Inilah cara kami berkongsi sebahagian kecil keunikan Malaysia dengan dunia, sambil meraikan keindahan rantau ini bersama-sama.[/p][p]Geng, pengembaraan baru bermula dan yang luarbiasa masih menanti![/p][p]Terima kasih kerana bersama kami. Teruskan bermain, teruskan menjelajah dunia Upin & Ipin Universe![/p][p][b]Betul, betul, betul![/b][/p][p]— Pasukan Pembangunan Upin & Ipin Universe[/p][p]@ Streamline Studios / Les’ Copaque[/p]

notes.title: Post-Launch Progress: Weekly Updates Begin
notes.notes: [p][b]Hey Everyone,[/b][/p][p]Dev team here with an update.[/p][p] [/p][p]Now that we’re in the post-launch phase, we’re shifting into long-term expansion and bugfixes. [/p][p] [/p][p]We’re currently finding our rhythm, aiming for a weekly patch cadence. These typically alternate between platforms—for example, PlayStation one week, PC the next. Though most improvements are global, with some platform-specific differences.[/p][p] [/p][p]This weekend, we’re hard at work preparing the next PlayStation patch, with the Steam update to follow shortly after.[/p][p]We’re committed to weekly updates, addressing critical issues piece by piece. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Key Priorities[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Player Camera[/b]: Especially in 2-player mode, the camera needs to better handle open-world environments.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bike Handling & Navigation[/b]: Improvements to bike physics, camera control, and cases where players get stuck.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Main Quest Marker[/b]: Under certain conditions, the main quest marker disappears, leading to confusion. We're fixing that.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save File System[/b]: Several weaknesses affect performance and reliability, particularly on lower-end systems that once fixed should strengthen performance on all devices. [/p][/*][*][p][b]UI Improvements[/b]: We're exploring new UI elements to improve orientation. A toggleable “Immersive Mode” is one potential option, though still under design discussion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]A bug around FAA[/b] after the last UNREAL ENGINE upgrade has snuck into the build, causing subtle but present ghosting-pixelation render issue that needs fixing. FAA (Fast Approximate Anti-Aliasing) is a post-processing effect that smooths out jagged edges and it is not behaving correctly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Streamer Mode [/b]with music not associated with the TV show to avoid triggering the copyright algorithm. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Longterm,[/b] a key request from fans is expanding collectable resources in the world and how they are connected.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Near-Term Fixes (Expected This Week)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players on older hardware should no longer lose progress due to save file corruption.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ehsan’s Quests[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed quest-stalling bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered cooking difficulty to improve quest flow.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Camera Improvements[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Default camera snap disabled.[/p][/*][*][p]Bike camera rotation enabled.[/p][/*][*][p]Acceleration mapped to L1/R1.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]RC cars and players no longer get stuck on each other.[/p][/*][*][p]Sudden NPC appearances near water have been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple UI bugs in the Fishing Game have been fixed, improving the experience overall.[/p][/*][*][p]Missing golden/legendary critters in Malay now properly register for achievements, along with other related fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]The major “endless yellow loading icon” bug on PlayStation is resolved and included in the previous patch. [/p][/*][*][p]Night-time scenes have been significantly brightened.[/p][/*][*][p]Various smaller hitches in the main quest have been fixed. [/p][/*][*][p]Various language & localisation tweaks. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Your Feedback is Driving This[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]Many of these fixes are based directly on community feedback. We encourage everyone to join us on [url="https://discord.gg/7wmUAz5b"]Discord[/url] and continue sharing your experiences. Your input has been invaluable in helping us fine-tune the balance and feel of the open world—especially over the past week.[/p][p]Thanks for being part of the journey![/p][p] [/p][p]—The Dev Team[/p]
